blocks.text: MANDAUE CITY, Cebu — The national government should regain control over grid planning, a function that should no longer be entrusted to the privately owned National Grid Corporation of the Philippines (NGCP). In a statement, the Cebu Energy Rights Advocates (CERA) said it supported proposals raised during a Sept. 21 joint hearing of the House committees on Energy, Visayas Development, and Legislative Franchises to refocus NGCP on fast-tracking projects that would ensure inter-island connectivity. “It is becoming clear that the recent red and yellow alerts in the Visayas, while caused by the unscheduled shutdown of several power plants, were exacerbated by […]...
